hash_audit.note: The root-gen1 and external-context result files store only a picks path, not a picks digest.

point_in_time_audit.model_architectures: pass; strictly-prior folds and all-candidate target-day mutation are recorded
point_in_time_audit.root_gen1: code is prior-only for the six implemented specifications, but the required target-day mutation artifact is absent
point_in_time_audit.external_context: all mapped external source dates are strictly earlier than the TSE date; maximum age is 3 days; the required source-date mutation artifact is absent
point_in_time_audit.policy_universe: round-one state variables and pair returns are prior-only
point_in_time_audit.online_ensemble: selection precedes state update in code, but the recorded mutation test strips all outcomes and verifies only outcome-independent O02, not stateful O01/O03 target-date invariance
point_in_time_audit.market_residual: same-date market return is used only in historical targets; beta is shifted one code session
point_in_time_audit.tdnet_text: zero future-publication violations; missing pages are not encoded as no event; historical cache observation-time provenance is unavailable

material_issues.issue: The locked criterion requires wins against at least four of five unrelated splits, but only four unrelated splits are implemented. The adjacent-horizon clause is reported but not included in the decision boolean.
material_issues.correction: Withdraw retain_for_forward_shadow=true. It cannot be repaired by relabeling 4/4 as 4/5; the missing comparator requires a new locked run.

material_issues.issue: Only 6 of 18 registered hypotheses are evaluated. Family controls, familywise multiplicity, and target-day mutation required by the protocol are absent.
material_issues.correction: Treat this artifact as a partial generation-one screen only. Z06 is not an admissible selected specification.

material_issues.issue: The eight hypotheses are scored, but required monthly result vectors, source-date mutation, and moving-block familywise lower bounds are absent.
material_issues.correction: X06 remains an unadjusted exploratory point estimate; no shadow or production decision is admissible.

material_issues.issue: The protocol requests target-day mutation and independent P&L recomputation. The runner mutates all outcomes and compares only O02, which is outcome-independent; it does not empirically test O01/O03 same-day invariance.
material_issues.correction: Arithmetic is now independently verified, and source order is PIT by inspection. Record the missing stateful mutation test before calling protocol compliance complete.

material_issues.issue: Several displayed experiments are exact duplicates, so they are not independent confirmations and raw candidate counts overstate breadth.
material_issues.correction: Deduplicate H01/H04, T02/T10-top1, and the common G0 control when summarizing evidence.

material_issues.issue: The 88-session, five-month, discontinuous source-complete sample is not comparable to the 266-session price-only samples; archive observation-time provenance is unavailable.
material_issues.correction: Report T02 separately and retain exploratory-only status.

corrected_decisions.model_architectures: reject all 13 new models; control remains comparison-only
corrected_decisions.policy_round1: H12 is descriptive only and failed familywise uplift
corrected_decisions.policy_round2: withdraw forward-shadow retention because the locked specificity rule was not implemented
corrected_decisions.online_ensemble: reject O01-O03 on returns; no production change
corrected_decisions.market_residual: reject R01; it is worse than R00
corrected_decisions.tdnet_text: T02 is the strongest point estimate but remains a frozen exploratory forward hypothesis only; no production promotion
corrected_decisions.overall: No v0.10 artifact supports a production replacement. The only worthwhile forward-only leads are T02 and, after a clean new registration rather than the invalid round-two decision, the momentum-diversification family.
